changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 8c, item 3: daemon install and onboard now share one install pipeline. New daemon/environment.ts function resolveManagedServiceAnswers(config, catalogs, dreamuxBin, startService, dryRun, host, env, nodeProbe?, execDirProbe?) replaces the fallback-exec-dirs / provider-binary-resolution / stable-Node-selection block each of runDaemonInstall (daemon/install.ts) and runOnboard (onboard/run.ts) used to hand-roll separately. config/catalogs are nullable to reproduce onboard's existing dry-run-has-no-real-config gate; daemon install always passes non-null values. runOnboard calls the shared resolver only when registerService is true, unchanged from today's gate; when false it keeps today's literal {nodeBin: process.execPath, providerBinChecks: [], fallbackDirs: []} defaults. Every branch (dry-run, no-config, registerService false) was traced against both current function bodies and reproduces the exact existing behavior. One call-order change falls out of sharing a single function: runOnboard used to select the stable service Node before writing config/state files and before provider-binary resolution; it now selects Node inside the shared pipeline, after those writes and after provider-binary resolution (daemon install's existing order). Node selection is side-effect-free and never throws (its own probes/capture calls are wrapped in try/catch), so this has no observable production effect; it only changes call order for a test double that records call sequence. ServiceInstallAnswers.providerBinChecks also becomes a required field (was optional): both producers always set it now, so the optional-with-fallback reader in daemon/environment.ts's serviceProviderBinChecks is simplified accordingly. This is a pure internal extraction with no output, CLI, or config-shape change.
